pages.text: A compact, silent work light for walls and ceilings. Emits $(bold)light 12$() while drawing $(bold)50 W$(). Works without oxygen and adds no room heat.$(br2)Link it to your grid or an isolated Cell Dock with the Conduit Binder. Like other ordinary lights, it is shed before life support during a brownout.

Empty-hand right-click switches it on or off. Switched-off lamps draw nothing. Binder use selects or clears links instead of toggling.$(br2)Requires a solid mounting face. Removing the support drops the lamp; it does not seal a hole in a room.
